snippet.title: GAME DROP NAME REVEAL! | MINECRAFT MONTHLY
snippet.description:
It’s time to interrogate clouds to see if we can find out the name of our next game drop!

In this episode of Minecraft Monthly, we’ll be covering:
• The name for our next game drop!
• What features are included in the drop?
• A brand-new Minecraft album with ambient music released on Spotify
• The Minecraft Time Capsule + The Time Capsule Add-On

Get your own Time Capsule Add-On here: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/oreville-studios/time-capsule-add--on/5877952a-9539-449b-881e-b2962d619363

Check out the new Minecraft album on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/432UYeCDyZIKh9TyBThLxP?si=wz7IwLpTQC6g9NxrFvKKLg
